- Functionality and behavior remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the transit-route-query skill for city bus and metro route planning.
- Instantly queries optimal transit routes between any two locations within a city.
- Supports fastest, least transfers, and least walking strategies; prioritizes metro when available.
- Zero configuration required—ready to use out-of-the-box.
- Provides detailed route information, including transfers, walking distance, and station details.
- Does not support intercity routes, driving, or real-time bus arrival info.
